removability.rationale: Two deletable directories plus one section in the Pokémon page; no nav links to abilities. Only blemish is the `hidden` flag threaded through the shared Card/cardsFor/PokemonCard path, which would linger as dead code unless cleaned.

app/server/api/team.get.ts:49 — team endpoint builds its own sprite via spriteUrl() even though the default-pokemon record is already in hand
app/app/pages/index.vue:48 — home page re-implements the sprite URL inline from mediaBase, bypassing the helper
app/server/api/species.get.ts — species payload ships no sprite field at all, so a default-variety sprite fix on the home page needs a server change plus a client change
app/server/api/moves/[name].get.ts:6 — effect-extraction snippet (short_effect → flavor → null) duplicated with abilities/[name].get.ts:6
changeability.rationale: Most fixes land in the well-named server helpers, but the card-sprite invariant is constructed in three places and the home page's card list is assembled ad hoc, so the Deoxys-style sprite fix would not be one edit. The 'English effect' fallback is also copy-pasted between two handlers.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:1 — all PokeAPI knowledge (base URL, /api/v2/ prefix, cache, 404 mapping) behind one thin module
app/app/composables/format.ts:41 — usePageData/usePageTitle give pages a single narrow seam to the internal /api
app/app/composables/team.ts:10 — shared team state is explicit, cookie-backed, no hidden globals
app/app/components/CardList.vue:6 — components are pure props in / slots out

coupling.rationale: Server and client are cleanly separated by the internal /api boundary and every PokeAPI detail lives in one module. Minor tangles: duplicated humanize across bundles and page types owned by components.

evidence: app/server/utils/pokeapi.ts:100 — cardsFor() centralizes ref→species-card mapping (dedupe, alt-form exclusion, dex order) for three of four card lists
app/app/components/CardList.vue — one list component reused by moves, abilities, types and home pages
app/app/components/PageSection.vue — section+heading+aria-labelledby invariant in one component
app/app/components/TypeBadge.vue:2 — small boolean flags (link, large) stretch one component across contexts
app/app/pages/index.vue:39 — home page re-derives card shape and type-label fallback (index.vue:49) instead of reusing the shared card abstraction
abstraction_design.rationale: The components and helpers are designed around the app's real variation (card lists, sections, badges, move tables) and a Moves-like Items section could be mostly assembled from them. Slight copy-paste at the edges: the home page's card construction and the boolean-flag rendering in TypeBadge.

findings.issue: Sprite URL construction duplicated: home page builds it inline while three other lists use spriteUrl()/cardsFor(); a default-variety sprite fix must land in three places and species.get.ts ships no sprite field
findings.suggestion: Have server/api/species.get.ts return the sprite (via the shared spriteUrl or the default Pokémon's sprite) and delete the inline construction; move default-variety sprite resolution into cardsFor/spriteUrl so one fix covers every list

findings.issue: humanize implemented identically in both bundles (app/composables/format.ts:1 and server/utils/pokeapi.ts:39); a change to name formatting must be made twice and can drift
findings.suggestion: Move humanize (and dexNumber) to Nuxt 4's shared/ directory, which exists precisely for app↔Nitro reuse

findings.issue: Effect-extraction fallback (English short_effect → latest flavor → null) copy-pasted in abilities/[name].get.ts:5
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared englishEffect(resource) helper next to latestFlavorText in server/utils/pokeapi.ts

findings.issue: Page-level data types imported from component files (ChainNode from EvolutionNode.vue, MoveRow from MovesTable.vue), coupling pages to component internals
findings.suggestion: Move the shared interfaces to a types module (e.g. shared/types or app/types) and import from there in both the components and pages

findings.issue: `hidden` flag on Card/cardsFor exists only to serve the abilities page; removing abilities leaves dead plumbing across pokeapi.ts, CardList and PokemonCard
findings.suggestion: Either keep card rendering fully generic (drop `hidden` and render the note in the ability page via a slot) or accept and document the abilities-only flag

findings.issue: Type-label fallback `labels[t] ?? humanize(t)` re-implemented in three places (index.vue:49, pokemon/[name].get.ts:74, team.get.ts:57)
findings.suggestion: Resolve type labels once on the server (a typeLabel(name) helper in pokeapi.ts) and let pages render labels verbatim

summary: A well-seamed Nuxt 4 app: every PokeAPI detail sits behind server/utils/pokeapi.ts, pages consume a clean internal /api via usePageData, and components are small, prop-driven and reused across all card lists. Features are easy to delete and an Items section would assemble almost entirely from existing pieces. The main editability cost is the home page, which duplicates sprite-URL and type-label logic instead of reusing the shared card abstraction, so sprite- and card-level fixes land in multiple places.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and all links
scenarios.notes: Delete two directories and the Abilities PageSection in pokemon/[name].vue:167. No nav links. Optional cleanup of the `hidden` flag in pokeapi.ts/PokemonCard.vue, otherwise it lingers as dead code.

scenarios.notes: cardsFor/spriteUrl (pokeapi.ts:54,107) covers move/ability/type lists in one edit, team.get.ts is a one-liner since it already fetches the default Pokémon, but the home page builds its sprite inline (index.vue:48) and species.get.ts ships no sprite field, so the fix must be re-implemented and a server payload change made. One fix does not cover every list.
